steps.text:
The tests pass (3 passed). The fix is complete:

- The validation regex `(?:\d+[hms])+` correctly matches sequences of digit-unit pairs.
- All 3 tests pass: `test_seconds`, `test_hours_only`, and `test_hours_and_minutes`.
